title: Restricted Standard-WOFOST One-Day Rate Provider Boundary
provider_role: purely evaluate source-bound one-day WOFOST rates from immutable parameters, explicit forcing/context, a read-only crop state view and accepted water-process aggregates; never mutate crop state

immutable_parameter_set.ownership: shared immutable parameter object referenced by crop/template identity, not duplicated per column
does_not_contain: SPAN or DVSEND because F-WOF26 owns those structural rules

state_view.name: wofost_one_day_rate_state_view_t
state_view.source: assembled read-only from wofost_crop_owner_state_t plus immutable SSA/SPA canopy coefficients
state_view.critical_rule: the rate provider must not read owner%biomass internals directly; the owner/view layer supplies the semantic scalars

prepared_assimilation.name: wofost_prepared_assimilation_t
prepared_assimilation.persistence: event-local or worker scratch only; never committed column state

assemble_state_view.semantic_signature: owner + SSA + SPA -> read-only DVS/WRT/WST/WSO/WLV/LAI/LAIEXP view
assemble_state_view.owner: crop owner/view layer, not rate physics
fail_closed: inactive crop when active view requested

prepare_assimilation.semantic_signature: immutable parameters + state view + explicit prepare forcing -> prepared actual PGASS
prepare_assimilation.time_identity: no date/day-number input; solar geometry is already explicit

finalize_rates.semantic_signature: immutable parameters + same pre-event state view + finalize forcing/accepted aggregates + prepared PGASS -> one-day rate packet
finalize_rates.critical_lineage_precondition: accepted IQROT/IPTRA must already represent the accepted crop window; the rate evaluator cannot reconstruct or certify F-KT provenance from scalar values alone

same_state_view_rule.reason: B1.10 computes PGASS and all same-day growth/death rates from the pre-integration crop state; F-WOF26 mutates state only after the rate packet is complete
same_state_view_rule.forbidden: reassemble the finalize state view from a partially updated candidate

reference_GLIAEXP_rule.post_threshold: set lai_exponential_rate_recomputed=false; F-WOF26 consumes the stored B1.10 compatibility carryover

dependency_direction: crop owner/view -> semantic rate state view
immutable crop parameter store -> rate provider
F-WOF26 structural integrator consumes packet and owns mutation

production_readiness_findings.recommended_smallest_next_production_sea: implement and qualify semantic read-only rate-state view assembly before broad rate equations
